messages:
megan-cs: Hi team — OmniApp (org_org_789abc) reported that a service-account key provisioned via SSO only has embeddings scope and now their generation and rerank calls are 403'ing. They are blocked in production. Repro below.

leo-engr: can you paste the trace id + exact curl they used? also which endpoint (chat/generate, /v1/rerank, embeddings)?

megan-cs: reproduction summary from customer:
```
# generation attempt using svc acct key
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-omni-svcacct-xxxx' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-base-1","input":"ping"}'
# response 403
# body: {"error":"forbidden","message":"missing scopes: generation, rerank"}
# trace_id: t-0a1b2c3d4e5f
```
They also tried /v1/embeddings which succeeds. So key only has embeddings.

anya-sre: thanks. is this the SSO provisioning flow (scim/okta) or a manual svcacct creation? if SCIM, we should check the claim mapping.

megan-cs: SCIM provisioning via Okta -> our provisioning lambda. Customer says they selected the "service account" tile in our app during SSO onboarding. They expected a multi-scope key for app usage.

deploy-bot: provisioning-log: 2045678899 - created svcacct for org_org_789abc, scopes=["embeddings"], created_by=okta-scim, metadata={template: service-app-default}

samir-se: probable cause: the default template for SSO-created svcacct was tightened last month to reduce blast radius (only embeddings). That regressed app onboarding where customers expect inference + rerank. Quick workaround: create a scoped API key from Console with generation+rerank, or issue an org master key (not ideal for security/compliance).

megan-cs: customer is PCI-sensitive and can't use org master key. They want either (a) reprovision their svcacct with correct scopes or (b) a minimal hotfix so newly provisioned SSO svcacct includes generation + rerank.

leo-engr: agreed hotfix sounds reasonable. plan: revert template change for SSO svcacct so template=service-app-default includes [embeddings,generation,rerank] for orgs in "trustedapps" onboarding flow. I'll do a quick patch and feature-flag it behind rollout. Need @anya to validate SCIM claim passthrough.

anya-sre: I'll validate the SCIM mapping and run a smoke test repro with OmniApp staging credentials once patch is live. Also will add an alert if provisioning creates svcacct with only embeddings for orgs that requested app-type.

samir-se: I'll add a KB entry for support with repro steps and the temporary CLI command to reprovision an existing svcacct: 
```
redwoodctl svcacct update --org org_789abc --key svcacct_id --scopes embeddings,generation,rerank
```
(need console perms)

megan-cs: action items: (1) @leo roll out template change behind flag and post PR link, (2) @anya test SCIM mapping + confirm smoke results to customer, (3) @samir publish KB + share temporary CLI command with OmniApp. I'll keep customer looped and escalate if anything slips.

leo-engr: ok I'm on it. PR shortly.

anya-sre: scheduling smoke test in 30m.

megan-cs: thanks everyone — marking as high priority. OmniApp is currently degraded for their chat/rerank features. Will update when customer confirms. :thumbsup:
